conflicts: Warcraft Tavern guide gives no per-item data, so no item-level conflicts; Wowhead Forever used throughout.
Set bonus text for Embrace of the Viper in Forever differs from guide's vague 'serpent Cat Form' note only in being undocumented there (Wowhead lists Dream Venom 5pc).

wowtbc.gg lists 14 extra boss/trash items (Searing Blade, Bristlebark Boots, Mystic's Robe, Stormbringer Belt, Hulking Bands, Feral Buckler, Sanguine Sandals, Wrangler's Belt, Lead Band, Wrangler's Cloak, Volcanic Rock Ring, Prospector's Woolies, Gargoyle's Bite, War Paint Bindings). timesaver.gg (Wowhead-linked IDs) lists none of them and Wowhead Forever tooltips do not attribute them to WC; most are classic world-drop BoE names. Treated as unconfirmed and excluded.
gaps: kills/drops counts unavailable; only drop chance % from tooltip.

Deviate Scale items, Slick Deviate Leggings, Boahn drops (Brambleweed Leggings 5422, Boahn's Fang 5423) not listed as WC drops by tooltip or not checked; Kresh/Skum/others may have extra drops not discovered.
Trigore the Lasher (rare) and Deviate Faerie Dragon (rare) included; Verdan level 21 from NPC tooltip. Lord Cobrahn/Pythas etc are 'Fanglords'.
Warcraft Tavern guide says boss level 20-22 and min entry level 10; no new bosses noted vs classic (guide mentions changed loot and a druid serpent Cat Form set bonus).

Per wowtbc.gg loot table, these items could not be ID-resolved (item ID unknown, not in output): Searing Blade, Bristlebark Boots, Mystic's Robe, Stormbringer Belt, Hulking Bands, Feral Buckler, Sanguine Sandals, Wrangler's Belt, Lead Band, Wrangler's Cloak, Volcanic Rock Ring, Prospector's Woolies, Gargoyle's Bite, War Paint Bindings. Bulk ID scanning was blocked by the permission system; IDs 266000-277000 were probed and none matched.
Item IDs for 6 added items came from timesaver.gg and verified via Forever tooltip; Talbar Mantle and Quagmire Galoshes quest rewards lack IDs.
notes_orchestrator: 28 boss/rare items cross-checked against timesaver.gg (exact match). Trigore the Lasher items and Snakeskin Bag come from Wowhead tooltips only.
